reason_no_direct_domains: All 6 platforms require JavaScript rendering and/or authenticated sessions to display actual domain listings. Web search and fetch attempts returned login walls, JS-only apps, or blurred domain names.

expireddomains_net.access_method: Free account required for full access; deleted domains page exists at /deleted-domains/ but requires login to see listings
expireddomains_net.database_size: 677 TLDs supported, thousands of domains updated daily
expireddomains_net.notes: THE largest expired domain database. Free registration unlocks all filters including keyword search, DA sort, backlink filtering. Essential first signup.

sedo.access_method: JavaScript-only app; requires account for bidding. Expiring domains page is a SPA that doesn't render without JS.
sedo.database_size: 2,000+ domains available daily in expiring auctions
sedo.pricing: Auctions start from $79; platform focuses on premium acquisitions ($500-$50K+)
sedo.signup_cost: Free to browse, bidding requires account
sedo.notes: NOT ideal for budget domain hunting ($5-$50). Better for premium acquisitions. Auction duration: 7 days. Also tracked by ExpiredDomains.net under Sedo sections.
sedo.priority: LOW for budget hunting, MEDIUM for premium finds

catchdoms.access_method: Free signup shows 10 domains with blurred names. Pro plan ($TBD/mo) unlocks 370K+ domains, CSV export, API, MCP server.
catchdoms.database_size: 181,758 domains in database (as of page load); tracks 55,000+ daily from 12 platforms

quality_score_system.recommendation: Filter score 50+ to skip spam; below 30 is almost always low quality

catchdoms.apify_notes: Official CatchDoms actor on Apify (joined Mar 2026, 25 users, 84% success rate). Connects to official API, not scraping.
catchdoms.signup_cost: Free (blurred names) / Pro for full access
catchdoms.notes: Best aggregator. Quality score system is excellent for filtering. Has MCP server for AI-assisted workflows. Apify actor provides programmatic access.
catchdoms.priority: HIGH - sign up for free tier, evaluate Pro

flippa.access_method: JavaScript SPA; domain listings require JS rendering. Listing fees start at $29 + 10% success fee.
flippa.pricing_notes: Average domain sale ~$15K. GoDaddy Auctions better for sub-$500 domains.
flippa.signup_cost: Free to browse, listing requires payment
flippa.notes: NOT ideal for expired domain hunting. Better for buying established websites/businesses with revenue. Domains listed here are premium-priced.

moonsy.access_method: Was free, NOW requires paid subscription. Page timed out on fetch attempt.
moonsy.notes: UI resembles ExpiredDomains.net. Formerly popular with PBN builders. Now paywalled. BlackHatWorld users report it became non-free. Consider alternatives like ExpiredDomains.net (free) or CatchDoms.
moonsy.priority: LOW - paywalled, better free alternatives exist

dynadot.access_method: Account required + $5 minimum spending before bidding on expired auctions. Closeout page returned 403.

auction_details.late_bid_extension: 5 minutes if bid in last 5 min
auction_details.closeout_pricing: Fixed price, decreasing daily for 5 days (domains that got no auction bids)

dynadot.signup_cost: Free signup + $5 minimum spend to bid
dynadot.notes: Less competition than GoDaddy. Closeouts are the sweet spot - fixed price, first-come for domains that didn't sell. Also tracked by CatchDoms. Worth signing up for the closeout deals.
dynadot.priority: MEDIUM-HIGH - less competition, good closeout deals

key_insights.market_state_2026: Expired domains still provide SEO boost in 2026 BUT relevance matters more than raw DA. Random strong backlinks won't help if niche doesn't match. Clean history + niche alignment = success.
key_insights.best_free_path: ExpiredDomains.net (signup) -> OpenPageRank API (bulk DA check) -> OpenLinkProfiler (backlink verify) -> SpamZilla free (spam check top 25/mo)
key_insights.best_paid_path: CatchDoms Pro (aggregated data) -> SpamZilla ($37/mo, 1850 domains/mo) -> DomCop (90+ metrics)
key_insights.automation_opportunity: CatchDoms Apify Actor + OpenPageRank API + OpenRank.io = fully automated pipeline scanning 55K+ domains/day with free authority checks
key_insights.abtdomain_goldmine: 1000-1500 aged (20+yr) domains enter pending delete DAILY. These are high-priority targets with established authority. Need browser access to view lists.
key_insights.godaddy_closeout_roi: Sprint 7 noted 400% median ROI on TF 15+ closeouts ($5-11). DomCop and ExpiredDomains.net both track GoDaddy closeouts with metrics.
key_insights.catchdoms_mcp_server: CatchDoms Pro includes MCP server for AI-assisted workflows. Could integrate directly with Claude Code for domain evaluation.
